fusions.name: Scent and Chomp
fusions.desc: A bite that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 10 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: Thrashes a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 28 damage to everything caught in it and 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Closing Circle
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Fed and Fierce
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
